text: {"lessons":["My account value rose overall while I mostly stayed invested, so I should not trade merely because a price has moved; past changes do not predict future ones.","Selling Stock B, D, and A above my average cost felt rewarding, but a gain relative to my purchase price alone is not a reason to sell.","I should review each holding in the context of my whole portfolio and follow consistent goals-based rules, rather than let regret or the urge to lock in a gain drive decisions."]}
